material.description: From the user: three-letter names can be scaled larger than they are. In js/client/widgets.js (portraits kind, badge strip at the top of the tile since c9896529) size the badge font from the tile width and the letter count: one or two letters larger than three, three letters filling about 90 percent of the tile width without clipping (budget for the widest capitals such as W and M: use a measured or conservative em-per-letter, not a fixed pixel size), bold, still low-contrast so the icon stays the focus, still capitals. It must scale with the tile (portraits.fit shrinks tiles) and not overflow at the smallest fit size. Existing no-badge rendering unchanged. Acceptance: CI green on ci and pages (note the first-draw median; never change the ceiling); a lobby screenshot shows three-letter badges filling their tiles with no clipping. Witness: browser lane screenshot. Ownership: js/client/widgets.js only.

material.resolution: Font = floor(min(inner*0.9/(letters*0.94), inner*0.4)), inner=tile-4, min 6px, at build and fit relayout. Pages run for this sha cancelled by newer push (concurrency). Lobby screenshot left to the browser lane.
